commands.name: Unlimited health
commands.description: Protects your heroes from health loss during a solo run.

commands.name: Set Industry
commands.description: Sets the current Industry balance to the entered amount, up to 9,999,999.

commands.name: Set Science
commands.description: Sets the current Science balance to the entered amount, up to 9,999,999.

commands.name: Set Food
commands.description: Sets the current Food balance to the entered amount, up to 9,999,999.

commands.name: Set Dust
commands.description: Sets the current Dust stock, from 1 up to the floor limit.

commands.name: Free construction
commands.description: Removes the resource cost of placing modules in the dungeon.

commands.name: Defeat monsters in one hit
commands.description: Makes a damaging hit defeat a monster in a solo run.

commands.name: Resource multiplier
commands.description: Multiplies positive resource gains during a solo run.

commands.name: Movement speed multiplier
commands.description: Multiplies hero movement speed during a solo run.

commands.name: Free blueprint research
commands.description: Removes the Science cost of starting and rerolling blueprint research.

commands.name: Free hero healing
commands.description: Removes the Food cost of manually healing a hero.

commands.name: Instant research
commands.description: Completes blueprint research immediately, even with no doors left to open.

commands.name: Unlimited active skill duration
commands.description: Keeps active skill effects running past their normal duration or room event.

commands.name: No active skill cooldown
commands.description: Lets you reuse active skills as soon as their effects end.
